title: Read like an editor
body: Mark up the paragraph the way you would with a pen.
instruction: Choose a tool, then select the words you want to mark. Select a marked word again to remove it.
passage: A landscape is built from a [[foreground]], a [[middle ground]] and a [[backdrop|bd]]. Depth is a [[choice]], not an accident — so decide which plane carries the [[idea]] and let the others support it.
